problem: A resolved module/package/source-set dependency edge violates the repository declared allowed-edge policy.
rationale: Architecture is an owner-selected graph contract, not a universal MVVM/Clean Architecture/layering requirement. A resolved graph can prove a forbidden configured edge without guessing architecture from class names.
applicability: An explicitly configured node mapping and allowed/forbidden directed edges over the actual compile/source dependency graph, with source-set/platform and test/generated scopes.
version_scope: Kotlin2.4.21 research baseline accessed2026-11-04; target/compiler/library/build facts must come from the actual project. This custom detector does not exist yet and no supported version/platform integration is established.
limitations: Konsist is an optional test/fact-source candidate, not proof of complete resolved symbol or Gradle/source-set dependency coverage. Its source/package-oriented architecture assertions are not automatically equivalent to this compiler-backed graph. Do not force conventional layer names or infer semantic edges from import spelling alone. Findings require the stated resolved contract and complete bounded prerequisites; unknown paths/identities/configuration must abstain. No automatic source rewriting or behavioral/resource/ABI changes are proposed.
